title: Leonardo da Vinci: Vitruvian Man (Proportions of the Human Body)
description: Iconic classical study illustrating the Vitruvian canon of human body proportions, geometry of circle and square, and standard 8-head proportional canon.

title: Leonardo da Vinci: Study on Proportions of Head and Profile
description: Anatomical study sheet detailing the proportional divisions of the human skull, facial features, eye-to-ear alignment, and nasal angles.
original_wikimedia_title: File:Leonardo da vinci, Study on the proportions of head and eyes.jpg

title: Albrecht Dürer: Proportions of the Female Body
description: Renaissance canon study from 'Vier Bücher von menschlicher Proportion' illustrating proportional guidelines, torso divisions, and grid lines for the female figure.
original_wikimedia_title: File:Albrecht Dürer - Studies on the Proportions of the Female Body - WGA07263.jpg

title: Leonardo da Vinci: Study of Hands and Forearm Gestures
description: Master study of hand contours, finger articulation, foreshortening, and resting posture with subtle shading and anatomical expression.
original_wikimedia_title: File:Leonardo da Vinci - RCIN 912558, A study of a woman's hands c.1490.jpg

title: Henry Gray: Skeletal Structure and Phalanges of the Hand
description: Anatomical plate from Gray's Anatomy demonstrating dorsal bone structure, carpal joints, metacarpal alignment, and phalangeal proportions.

title: Henry Gray: Muscles and Tendons of the Hand and Thenar Eminence
description: Detailed anatomical drawing showing deep and superficial palmar muscles, adductor pollicis, flexor tendons, and grip mechanics.

title: Multi-Part Mechanical Assembly Exploded View
description: Technical isometric exploded view drawing showing part disassembly axes, fasteners, concentric alignment centerlines, and assembly sequence.

title: Rotary Gear Pump Exploded Engineering Diagram
description: Vector exploded diagram showing spur gear meshing, drive shaft, casing, end-plate gaskets, and mechanical fluid displacement mechanism.

title: Historic Architectural Hardware: Hinges, Latch, and Pin Joinery
description: Measured technical drawing displaying strap hinge geometry, pintle pivot mechanics, door latch spring assemblies, and fastener details.
original_wikimedia_title: File:Drawing of Door and Latch Details in the Bolduc House in Ste Genevieve MO.png

title: Diamond Frame Bicycle Technical Diagram and Anatomy
description: Comprehensive vector technical drawing labeling all bicycle subsystems including frame geometry, drivetrain, crankset, forks, and wheel assembly.

title: Indian Auto-Rickshaw Profile and Three-Wheeler Geometry
author_or_source: Government of India / Public Domain Vector
description: Standard schematic profile of an Indian three-wheeled passenger auto rickshaw showing cab proportions, wheel spacing, and windshield rake angle.

title: Indian Cycle Rickshaw Mechanical and Passenger Frame Geometry
author_or_source: Government of India / Public Domain Vector
description: Vector schematic showing traditional cycle rickshaw tricycle layout, pedal chain drive, carriage seating frame, and canopy architecture.

title: Parallel One-Point Perspective Classical Exercise Sheet
description: Historical architectural training sheet illustrating horizon line, central vanishing point, converging orthogonal lines, and spatial depth division.
original_wikimedia_title: File:Drawing, Exercises in Parallel One-Point Perspective, ca. 1880 (CH 18397873).jpg

title: Two-Point Perspective Architectural Interior Room Grid
description: Two-point perspective grid demonstrating corner orientation, left and right vanishing points, floor tile grid projection, and furniture placement planes.

title: Three-Point Perspective Vertical and Horizontal Convergence Grid
description: Vector perspective diagram illustrating worm's-eye and bird's-eye view projections with three distinct vanishing points and foreshortening grids.

title: ISO 7001: Public Information Symbol - Toilets / Restroom
description: Official international standard pictogram representing public sanitary facilities with minimalist human figure silhouettes.

title: ISO 7001: Public Information Symbol - Elevator / Lift
description: Standard international wayfinding symbol displaying elevator cab, vertical directional motion indicators, and passenger figures.

title: ISO 7001: Public Information Symbol - General Information
description: Universal lowercase 'i' information sign standard used in public transit, museums, and civic facilities for orientation and wayfinding.

title: ISO 7010 W012: Warning - Electricity / High Voltage Hazard
description: Standard triangular safety warning sign featuring lightning bolt pictogram to alert to electrical hazards and energized equipment.

title: ISO 7010 W011: Warning - Slippery Surface Hazard
description: International hazard warning symbol illustrating slipping human figure and dynamic fall trajectory on wet or low-friction surfaces.

title: ISO 7010 F001: Fire Equipment - Fire Extinguisher
description: Standard rectangular emergency fire equipment symbol depicting fire extinguisher profile, hose, and flames in high-contrast graphics.

title: Nautilus Pompilius Chambered Shell with Logarithmic Golden Spiral
description: Cutaway photograph and geometric overlay of a chambered nautilus shell demonstrating equiangular growth, logarithmic spiral, and golden ratio proportions.

title: Natural Hexagonal Honeycomb Wax Cell Structure
description: Close-up nature study of apian honeycomb cells demonstrating regular hexagonal close-packing, minimal surface area efficiency, and structural rigidity.

title: Fibonacci Spiral and Golden Ratio Tiling Geometry
description: Mathematical and geometric diagram showing square tiling based on Fibonacci sequence (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21) inscribed with continuous golden spiral curve.

title: Diffuse Sphere Shading: Core Shadow, Terminator, and Gradient
description: Realistic matte surface sphere rendering demonstrating light source angle, highlight, diffuse falloff, shadow terminator line, and ambient occlusion.

title: Specular and Ambient Shading Model on Curved Surface
description: Curved spherical volume rendering illustrating specular highlight reflection, specular roll-off, diffuse half-tones, and core dark values.

title: Wood Anatomy: Cross Section with Annual Rings and Grain
description: Classical carpentry technical diagram showing heartwood, sapwood, annual growth rings, medullary rays, and grain orientation for timber rendering.
original_wikimedia_title: File:Cassells Carpentry.125 Log Showing Annual Rings.png

title: George Herriman: 4-Panel Sequential Narrative Comic Strip (1941)
description: Classic four-panel sequential art demonstrating narrative pacing, establishing setup, comedic confrontation, climax, and resolution across discrete frames.

title: George Herriman: 4-Panel Action Progression Sequence (1918)
description: Early narrative comic sequence showcasing character movement continuity, frame-to-frame staging, expressive body language, and environmental framing.

title: Dynamic Cinematic Storyboard Sequence and Keyframe Staging
description: Multi-panel production storyboard illustrating camera shot transitions, establishing shot, medium action framing, dynamic perspective, and directional vectors.
